title: WITH MY HANDS LIFTED UP

lines.text: And my mouth filled with praise,
I will bless Thee, O Lord. (3)
I will bless Thee, O Lord.

chords:
[Verse 1]
[D]With my [F#m]hands lifted [Bm]up,
And my [A]mouth filled with [D]praise,
With a heart of thanksgiving,
I will bless Thee, O Lord. (3)

[Verse 2]
With a heart of thanksgiving,
I will bless Thee, O Lord.
We bless Thee, O Lord, (2)
With a heart of thanksgiving,
We bless Thee, O Lord.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
With my hands lifted up,
And my mouth filled with praise,
With a heart of thanksgiving,
I will bless Thee, O Lord. (3)

[Verse 2]
With a heart of thanksgiving,
I will bless Thee, O Lord.
We bless Thee, O Lord, (2)
With a heart of thanksgiving,
We bless Thee, O Lord.
